name: Germantown Dental Group
description: A family dental practice in the Germantown section of Philadelphia offering general and preventive care.

hero.headline: Germantown Dental Group
hero.sub: General and family dentistry for the Germantown community, built on prevention and plain-language treatment plans.

items: Family and general dentistry for patients of every age
Restorative treatment for cavities and worn teeth
Rooted in the Germantown, Philadelphia community
Family-friendly scheduling for parents and kids together
Preventive-first approach to keep visits simple
Treatment plans explained in plain language

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Germantown Dental Group has served families in the neighborhood, focusing on care that keeps people coming back for checkups, not emergencies.
The practice keeps scheduling flexible for families who need to bring more than one patient in at a time.

items: Family scheduling means siblings and parents can often be seen back to back.
Every visit starts with a conversation about what you actually need, not a sales pitch.
Preventive care is the default recommendation whenever it is an option.

feature.heading: Family dentistry built for busy schedules
feature.text: Coordinated appointments mean fewer trips back and forth for parents managing more than one patient.

spotlight.heading: Preventive care, prioritized
spotlight.text: Cleanings and exams are positioned as the first line of defense, before restorative work is ever needed.
